description: Source code implementing Remote Reference (RRef) classes and related functions for PyTorch distributed RPC, including RRef, UserRRef, OwnerRRef, and associated error handling and messaging.

classes.name: RRef
classes.description: Base class representing a remote reference with methods for forking and error handling.

classes.name: UserRRef
classes.description: Derived class representing a user-side RRef, with methods for resource management and RPC communication.

classes.name: OwnerRRef
classes.description: Derived class representing an owner-side RRef, with methods for managing the value and future.

classes.name: RRefForkData
classes.description: Data structure for fork information of an RRef.

methods.name: RRef::fork
methods.description: Creates a fork of the RRef.

methods.name: RRef::handleError
methods.description: Handles errors related to RPC calls.

methods.name: UserRRef::tryDel
methods.description: Attempts to delete the user RRef.

methods.name: UserRRef::release_resources
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the RRef.

methods.name: UserRRef::toHere
methods.description: Fetches the RRef value from the owner via RPC.

methods.name: UserRRef::fork
methods.description: Creates a fork of the UserRRef.

methods.name: OwnerRRef::getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the owner RRef, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: OwnerRRef::hasValue
methods.description: Checks if the owner RRef has a value.

methods.name: OwnerRRef::getFuture
methods.description: Returns the future associated with the owner RRef.

methods.name: OwnerRRef::setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the owner RRef.

methods.name: OwnerRRef::setError
methods.description: Sets an error for the owner RRef.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a string representation of an RRef.
